## ✅ Pre-Submission Checklist

- [ ] My branch is synced with the latest `upstream/main`.
- [ ] My code adheres to the project's TypeScript and styling standards.
- [ ] I have run `npm run lint` and resolved all linting errors.
- [ ] I have run `npm run build` and verified that `tsc -b && vite build` succeeds with zero errors.
- [ ] I have verified responsiveness on both mobile and desktop screen sizes.
- [ ] If adding user-facing text, I updated both `en.json` and `fil.json` translation files.
- [ ] No proprietary tokens or paid API keys were added (keeping the app 100% free and open).
